title: Kowal513 - Your New Friendly Anvil
description: Kowal is the name of your new cool anvil friend. He stays in your workshops and waits for you to show him your new Mending book.
body:
**Kowal** is the name of your new cool anvil friend. He stays in your workshops and waits for you to show him your new Mending book.
He likes **cheetos** and **Sonic the Hedgehog**.
His life motto is **"Things worth fighting for - honor, friendship and a bag of Cheetos"**
